title: Wheeze Detection in Children During Dynamic Bronchial Situations Measured by WIM-PC™ Recording
brief_summary: The WIM-PC™ device, indicated for acoustic pulmonary function measurement that quantifies the presence of wheezing. This study was designed in order to evaluate the efficacy and safety of using the WIM-PC™ device for wheeze detection during dynamic bronchial situations in infants that were hospitalized as a result of asthmatic attack.
